title: Define crystal structures
action: Define the cubic CaF₂-type (space group Fm-3m) crystal structures for the four compounds: Be₂B, AlBeB, MgBeB, NaBeB. Specify atomic positions: Be at (0.25,0.25,0.25), B at (0,0,0); for the ternary phases, replace one Be atom with the substituting atom (Al, Mg, Na) at the same fractional coordinate.
description: Set up input structures for subsequent DFT calculations.

title: Run DFT volume scans
action: Perform DFT self-consistent field (SCF) calculations using the PBE-GGA exchange-correlation functional for each compound at a series of unit-cell volumes to obtain total energy vs. volume data.
description: Generate total energy versus volume data for each compound; optionally save a log file e_v_data.csv.

title: Fit equation of state and extract structural parameters
action: Fit the total-energy vs. volume data from step-02 to the Murnaghan equation of state. Extract the equilibrium lattice constant and bulk modulus for each compound. Save these values to a temporary intermediate file.
description: Intermediate file containing equilibrium lattice constants and bulk moduli for the four compounds. Downstream scored steps depend on these values.

title: Compute electronic structure at equilibrium volume
action: Using the equilibrium lattice constants from step-03, perform DFT SCF calculations at the equilibrium volume for each compound. Then compute the electronic band structure along high-symmetry lines and the density of states (DOS).
description: Produce band structure and DOS data required for the electronic quantity extraction.

title: Extract electronic quantities
action: From the band structure obtained in step-04, extract the valence bandwidth (energy difference between the top of the valence band and the bottom of the lowest valence band) and the Γ–X band gap (lowest conduction band at X minus highest valence band at Γ). From the DOS, extract the total DOS at the Fermi level and the B p-projected DOS at the Fermi level for each compound. Save these values to a temporary file.
description: Intermediate file containing the extracted electronic quantities.

title: Compile scored output
action: Read the structural parameters (from step-03) and electronic quantities (from step-05) and compile the final scored output file `computed_properties.json`, containing an array of four objects, one per compound (order: Be₂B, AlBeB, MgBeB, NaBeB). Each object must include the keys: compound, lattice_constant_angstrom, bulk_modulus_GPa, valence_bandwidth_eV, band_gap_Gamma_X_eV, total_DOS_at_EF_states_per_eV_cell, B_p_DOS_at_EF_states_per_eV_cell.
description: Final scored artifact containing the six required quantities for all four compounds. This is the only file the checker reads.
output_schema: Array of objects, each with keys: compound (string), lattice_constant_angstrom (number), bulk_modulus_GPa (number), valence_bandwidth_eV (number), band_gap_Gamma_X_eV (number), total_DOS_at_EF_states_per_eV_cell (number), B_p_DOS_at_EF_states_per_eV_cell (number). One entry per compound in the fixed order Be2B, AlBeB, MgBeB, NaBeB.
